books.title: Covered Copy
books.author: mkept
pages: FIELD COPY / The daylight survey stayed at the public entrance. This copy covers the lower approach and drainage cut.
Hold mouth: follow the old drain north of the kiln. The village well is a separate shaft and does not meet the stair.
Service 1842 is written on the survey drawer. The lower register is still filed under that number. -m

books.title: Entry Register
books.author: Civic Office
pages: SHELTER ENTRY / One entry per household. Tools and stores are entered separately. Visitors are not included in ration count.
This copy was damaged during the third move. Household totals were checked against the last ration issue before transfer below.
Pencil note: the orientation key was left beneath the survey model. Return it to the gate filing box after use. -mkept

books.title: Three Survey Layers
books.author: Orin
pages: SURVEY A / Emergency sleeping cuts, shallow heat trench, and a temporary intake along the clay seam. No school or market is shown.
SURVEY B / Civic ring complete. Market east, school west, and the cistern moved behind the new sound wall.
SURVEY C / Pressure works and Deep Line added below the civic ring. The later stone came from beneath the former safe seam.
Requisition references: B cites the shelter trench. C cites the completed cistern wall.

books.title: Heat Issue 12
books.author: Vaun
pages: Certified residents: 87. Winter heat issue: two baskets per resident for each cold cycle.
Public issue: 174 baskets. Private braziers are charged to their rooms and are not entered on the resident account.
Closed by Vaun: resident account balanced. Hearth-room issues remain on their separate docket.

books.title: Tuesday Copybook
books.author: Lower School
pages: TUESDAY / Measure the bean rows. Exchange two chalk ends for one clean slate. Return the lamp glass after sums.
Sella drew the market roof too high again. The leak is marked over the east stall, where the real roof still drips.
Home work: ask why the first families chose the warm stone instead of the east road. Bring one practical reason tomorrow.

books.title: Vent Stave
books.author: Lamp Office
pages: VENT OFFICE COPY / The clerk marks match the teaching strip beside the survey table. Each mark records one letter.
Emergency cut: [V][E][N][T] / [E][A][S][T] / [B][E][F][O][R][E] / [S][E][C][O][N][D] / [B][E][L][L].
Posted beside the east vent for the second-bell evacuation drill.

books.title: Founding Minutes
books.author: Civic Office
pages: EAST ROAD / Rejected. Eleven miles exposed; no running water beyond the quarry bend.
SHALLOW WORKS / Rejected. Estimated fuel loss exceeds stores before the next harvest.
DEEP CIVIC WORKS / Approved for stable heat, stable water, and cover during the long weather.
Clerk's note: the vote was taken from supply estimates and survey reports.

books.title: Filter Issue Ledger
books.author: Vaun
pages: FILTER CLOTH / received 12 bolts / cistern receipts 7 / unreceipted balance 5.
CHARCOAL / received 16 sacks / cistern receipts 10 / unreceipted balance 6.
Balances remain open pending the return chest and Hearth Row Three docket. -Vaun

books.title: Returned Goods
books.author: Stores Office
pages: RETURN MARKS / Blue stitch: cistern. Red stitch: public heat. Brass staple: private heat. Black wax: condemned.
Returned stock is entered by its mark, including unused material. Condition is recorded in the next column.
Hearth Row Three return: five cloth bolts and six charcoal sacks, all bearing brass staples.

books.title: Vaun Affidavit
books.author: Vaun
pages: I reconciled the stores after Nessa was removed. The missing material had authorized issue slips, but none named the cistern.
I kept the unreceipted stock in a second column. I should have brought that column to the hearing and did not.
The absent cloth count is the offset for this line: HMJHP MJFWYM YMWJJ FLFNSXY UZRU WJHJNUY.
The second column and pump receipts are filed with this statement. -Vaun

books.title: Mara Affidavit
books.author: Mara
pages: I wrote the diversion so crews could work around the school wall. I should have withdrawn every copy when the wall reopened.
A signed manual carries more weight than a spoken warning. I knew that when I allowed the wrong copy to circulate.
I retained the marked third edition with this statement. Every change remains in its original margin. -Mara

books.title: Shore Copybook
books.author: Sella
pages: My last line transferred backward when two damp sheets were stacked. I kept the transfer with the shoreline survey.
DZGVI PVVKH GSV YZXP LU GSV KZTV
Survey reference: the school roof is north of the long reed bed. The intake mark is on the reverse of the sheet.

books.title: Sample Note
books.author: Sella
pages: Sample taken behind the folded reeds at Intake A, not at the public landing. Upper water clear; lower draw grey with sediment.
Nessa labelled and sealed both vials. The hearing table held only the clear upper sample.
I delivered drawings of both layers to the Cistern Office before the hearing. The lower drawing was returned without a filing mark.

books.title: Sella Affidavit
books.author: Sella
pages: The hearing map was turned until the public landing covered Intake A. The survey marks on its reverse show the original bearing.
I kept the damp-transfer copy with the school plans. Its back carries the intake mark and my filing initial.
The lower sample existed, was labelled, and was omitted from the hearing display. -Sella

books.title: Third Bay Tolerances
books.author: Orin
pages: Third-bay marks are read from the low inspection rest. From standing height, the center cuts appear level.
Permitted lateral shift: one finger. Reading after the heat-shaft work: three fingers, with fresh dust at the east edge.
OLD NZIPH KLRMG MLIGS GSVM VZHG

books.title: Signed Safe
books.author: Orin
pages: CERTIFICATE / Third bay may remain open if heat load is reduced and the east brace is installed before the next cycle.
The load was not reduced. The delivered brace was short of its seat. I signed because immediate closure would have stranded the lower rooms.
The conditions were unmet when I signed. -Orin

books.title: Orin Affidavit
books.author: Orin
pages: The fracture predates Iss's final cut. His excavation added load to it. I measured both and reported only the latter.
I closed the inner seal after the outer control failed. It was the only lever I could still reach from the surviving floor.
My low inspection bearing and the third-bay section are filed with this statement. -Orin

books.title: Black Watch Rota
books.author: Brann
pages: BELL 7 / Toma, Leth. BELL 8 / Leth, Brann. BELL 9 / Brann, relief line unfilled.
The sound recorder failed twice that week. Lamp Office kept a long-and-short light copy of each toll.
Clerk rail: PNWEYRARIEIHMTHUINTPO / three rails / spaces omitted.

books.title: Time Correction
books.author: Brann
pages: A later hand entered Nessa on the bell-nine relief line. Her removal order predates that watch.
The clean alarm copy begins at bell nine. My stair mark and Toma's meal chit place the first alarm one bell earlier.
I amended this copy after the hearing. I did not correct the watch record when it could still have mattered. -Brann

books.title: Brann Affidavit
books.author: Brann
pages: The first alarm was bell eight. The clean copy begins at bell nine and adds Nessa to its previously empty relief line.
I was present for both watches. I allowed the later copy to stand because it carried two names and looked complete.
The unfilled relief cell and my original stair mark are filed with this statement. -Brann

books.title: A Warmer Account
books.author: Iss
pages: FIELD KEY: REEDS. I used the word from the first living plants found beyond the Deep Line.
KLI VMIJEFW SVIDLYIW EMK XLH LYMVG TRC GDFESX
I circulated this account to support reopening the surface route. I omitted the third-bay load warning. -Iss

books.title: Keepsake Receipt
books.author: Heat Office
pages: ITEM / Reed knot in sealed glass. Source: beyond Deep Line. Recovery tag: living green, damp at the root.
Filed copy: dry brown specimen, viability unconfirmed. The glass seal still carries the original green recovery tag.
Receipt and sealed specimen were entered under the same item number. -Heat Office

books.title: Iss Affidavit
books.author: Iss
pages: I called it mercy when I signed Averyn out of the roster. I believed a blank would spare her from the finding against her.
The fair copy begins with the account I wanted accepted. My correction cuts carry what I removed from it.
The surface had recovered. The third bay could not bear my excavation. I knew one fact and ignored the other. -Iss

books.title: Pump Complaints
books.author: Nessa Vale
pages: CYCLE 3 / Pressure loss at reed intake. Upper draw clear; lower draw grey with a metallic smell.
CYCLE 4 / Replacement cloth sheds when wet. Requested a stores comparison and second sample witness.
CYCLE 5 / Ordered to keep the public tap open. Filed both draws before removal. -Nessa Vale

books.title: Sample Register
books.author: Cistern Office
pages: SAMPLE MARKS / White seal: upper draw. Grey seal: lower draw. Reed cord: Intake A. Clay cord: Intake B.
Register order: intake, cycle, draw. Upper and lower samples remain separate because sediment settles below the clear water.
Hearing transfer sheet omits Intake A, lower draw, cycles 3 and 4.

books.title: Flush Configuration
books.author: Nessa Vale
pages: INTAKE A SEDIMENT FLUSH / A OPEN / B SHUT / MAIN FILTER OPEN / REED BYPASS SHUT / WASHOUT OPEN.
A valve pointer aligned with its pipe indicates open. A pointer set across the pipe indicates shut.
Take the lower-gauge reading after the washout runs clear. -Nessa Vale

books.title: Relief Roster
books.author: Brann
pages: Nessa Vale / cycles 1-4 / removed before cycle 5. Toma Rill / cycle 5 relief. Brann / cycle 5 watch witness.
The clean rota lists Nessa for cycle 5 and leaves out Toma. Toma's meal chit and Brann's stair mark both place him on duty.
Correction requested: identify the cycle 5 relief worker and restore the original entry.

books.title: Filter Invoice 44
books.author: East Market Cooperative
pages: Contract cloth carries blue thread through both selvages. Delivered cloth has blue surface dye and an unmarked inner weave.
Crate marks: 2-1 / 1-1 / 3-1 / 4-3 / 1-5. East Market uses its five-by-five stall register, row before column; I and J share a stall.
Invoice 44 was paid as contract grade. No substitution or damaged-goods credit appears on the purchase account.

books.title: Cache Reopening Slip
books.author: Civic Office
pages: CACHE 7-W / Access from the folded-reeds service path. Contents: contract filter, original purchase receipt, sealed discipline drafts A and B.
Transfer all three exhibits under one custody signature. Cabinet positions are marked FILTER / RECEIPT / DRAFTS.
Averyn: retain both drafts. Their changes determine whether the failure began with the worker or the supplied material.

books.title: Break Comparison
books.author: Averyn
pages: BREAK COMPARISON / Seven copied village houses retain records that differ from the Hold finding. Review them in any order.
Lamp: outage. Cairn: fracture. Coop: birds. Well: pressure. Watch: time. Warm: surface. Threshold: inner seal. Base: copied record.
At the base, compare the seven findings with the copied Record. Entry and return are through the village well.

books.author: Works Office
pages: COMMISSIONING ORDER / filter, lamp report, pressure review, survey, painted service line, key console.

WORKS LAMP CODE / five lamps per letter, read left to right. DIM=A; LIT=B. A AAAAA / B AAAAB / C AAABA / D AAABB / E AABAA / F AABAB / G AABBA / H AABBB / I ABAAA / J ABAAB / K ABABA / L ABABB / M ABBAA.
N ABBAB / O ABBBA / P ABBBB / Q BAAAA / R BAAAB / S BAABA / T BAABB / U BABAA / V BABAB / W BABBA / X BABBB / Y BBAAA / Z BBAAB.

INSPECTION / Line 1: inlet 15, outlet 14, return 0. Line 2: inlet 15, outlet 15, return 0. Line 3: inlet 14, outlet 14, return 0. Line 4: inlet 15, outlet 4, return 13.

books.title: mkept Admin Notes
books.author: mkept
pages: Made a clean world copy before we opened the lower region. Ash has video, Rook has route plans, and I have access records. Wren remembers turns before Rook shows them.
The Copperline account is genuine. Service 1842 still appears in the community archive when the direct server listing drops out.
There are four of us. The lower rooms have repeated things said only at camp. Start with who was present for each one. -mkept

books.title: Ash Field Notebook
books.author: Ash
pages: Rook set the supply order as LIGHT / FOOD / BUILD / RECORD and wrote ROOK beneath the barrel lid.
OCUYTKRVCNMIOITHCTMTSCAIAUONPTECE / four columns / repeated O columns remain left to right.
Camera cases follow the locker manifest. I kept their numbers out of this notebook in case the camp copy was taken. -Ash

books.title: Rook Route Changes
books.author: Rook
pages: Blocked the east throat after it opened before we reached its switch. I gave the replacement route only to Wren.
I changed the bridge span in camp while Ash was away and mkept was offline. The lower room used that revision the same night.
No clean copy of the revision existed. My marked sketch remained folded in my coat. -Rook

books.title: Witness Spool Index
books.author: automatic transcript
pages: CHANNEL W / packet 14: mkept login route. Packet 19: Ash camera cache. Packet 23: Rook bridge revision.
Packet 28: private remarks indexed by speaker name. Source sample matches Wren on the camp recorder.
Packets 14, 19, 23, and 28 were sent through the same outbound channel.

books.title: Averyn's Finding
books.author: Averyn
pages: FINDING / Nessa Vale followed the required sample procedure. Filter failure preceded her removal. The hearing display did not contain the complete filed pair.
Sources: lower-draw vials, contract filter remnant, purchase receipt, cycle 5 meal chit, and discipline drafts A and B.
Filed by Averyn, registrar and cistern analyst. Rejection note cites roster status and does not dispute the evidence.

books.title: Release Protocol
books.author: Averyn
pages: Return the six signed affidavits to their named cases. Leave the Averyn roster case empty.
Fit the Cistern Seal, System Key, and Protocol Bridge in their marked housings. One original of each is sufficient.
The final filing concerns whether my name is published. It does not authorize my continued confinement here.
After every person present has signed the floor register, turn the closing lever once. -Averyn

books.title: A Name Outside
books.author: Averyn
pages: AVERYN / registrar, cistern analyst, and author of the corrected finding.
Her name remains on the public copy. She is not entered again as a subject of the Record.
All access gates are open. The machinery has stopped.

books.title: The Chosen Blank
pages: At the subject's request, the final public name field remains blank. The supporting evidence is retained.
The blank applies only to her name. Nessa Vale's corrected finding and its sources remain in full.
All access gates are open. The machinery has stopped.
